description: Friday Apparel is FASHION FOR FANS. We are a Worldwide lifestyle brand, creating unique clothes, stickers, jewelry and home goods for FANS. We take your favorite movies and music and create merch that "makes a statement." Going on a Disney trip? Don't wear what everyone else is wearing. Wear Friday Apparel.
term_and_condition:

This Agreement contains the complete terms and conditions that apply to you becoming a Creator in Friday Apparel's Creator Program. The purpose of this Agreement is to allow HTML linking between your site and social media to Friday Apparel's web site. 

2. Creator Obligations

To begin the enrollment process, you will complete and submit the online application. Once your application is approved, it does not mean you will stay approved. We may re-evaluate your application at any time. We may react your application at our sole discretion. We may cancel your application if we determine that your social media and content are unsuitable for our Program, including if any content:

  • You may not create or design your website or any other website you operate, explicitly or implied in a manner which resembles our website, nor design your website in a manner which leads customers to believe you are Friday Apparel or any other affiliated business.

As a member of Friday Apparel's Creator Program, you will have access to a Creator Account Manager. Here you will be able to review our Program's details, and download your HTML code and coupon code. In order for us to accurately keep track of all guest visits from your site and social media to ours, you must use the HTML code that we provide for you for each swipe up, bio link, banner, text link, or other affiliate link you share. If you do not have a Swipe Up feature on Instagram, you can add your link to our bio, or use your affiliate coupon code for tracking.

Friday Apparel reserves the right, at any time, to review your placement and approve the use of your links and require that you change the placement or use to comply with the guidelines provided to you.

We may notify you of any changes to your site or social media posts that we feel should be made, or to make sure that your links to our web site are appropriate and to notify you further of any changes that we feel should be made. Friday Apparel reserves the right to terminate this Agreement and your participation in Friday Apparel's Creator Program immediately and without notice to you, should you commit fraud in your use of Friday Apparel's Creator Program, or should you abuse this program in any way. If such fraud or abuse is detected, Friday Apparel shall not be liable to you for any commissions for such fraudulent sales.

This Agreement will begin upon our acceptance of your Creator application, and will continue unless terminated hereunder.

Either you or we may end this Agreement AT ANY TIME, with or without cause, by giving the other party written notice via email. In addition, this Agreement will terminate immediately upon any breach of this Agreement by you.

You will create a password so that you may enter our secure Creator Account Interface. You will be able to receive your reports that will describe our calculation of the commission due to you.

8. Promotion Restrictions

You are free to promote your own web site and social media, but naturally any promotion that mentions Friday Apparel could be perceive by the public as a joint effort. You should know that certain forms of advertising are always prohibited by Friday Apparel. For example, advertising commonly referred to as "spamming" is unacceptable to us and could cause damage to our name. In addition, you may not advertise in a way that effectively conceals or misrepresents your identity, your domain name, or your return email address. You may use email newsletters to customers to promote Friday Apparel, so long as the recipient is already a subscriber of your services or web site, and recipients have the option to remove themselves from future mailings. You may post to Facebook groups to promote Friday Apparel, so longs as the Facebook group specifically welcomes commercial messages. At all times, you must clearly represents yourself, your web site and your social media as independent from Friday Apparel. If it comes to our attention that you are spamming, we will consider that cause for immediate termination of this Agreement and your participation in Friday Apparel's Creator Program. Any pending balances owed to you will not be paid if your account is terminated due to such unacceptable advertising or solicitation.

You are not allowed to share your HTML link or coupon code on any coupon sharing site, such as RetailMeNot.com, CouponCabin.com, Groupon.com, etc. If if it comes to our attention that you are placing your HTML link or coupon code on these sites, we will request immediate removal of the code, with a warning to your Creator account.
